_doc: Odds API monthly credit budget (research/platform_v2/API_CREDIT_BUDGET.md; Credit Plan A approved 2026-10-01: research/platform_v2/v2_13_october/CREDIT_AUDIT.md; final football coverage 2026-10-01: research/platform_v2/football_coverage/COVERAGE_DESIGN.md). HARD LIMIT = monthly_plan_limit (free plan, never purchased); SAFETY RESERVE = global_reserve_remaining; OPERATING BUDGET = monthly_target_max = hard limit - reserve. Consumer caps are planned allocations for the core; shadow football tiers have no planned allocation and run only on measured surplus (football_shadow_tiers). Optional consumers stop first.

football_daily_scan._note: core = football Tier 1 (E0/E1/SC0 h2h+totals; N1/D1/F1 h2h; config/football_coverage.yaml). Not stopped by its cap (documentary); pays per league only if a fixture kicks off within fixture_gate_hours and remaining >= hard_floor_remaining. Expected ~162/month in season, high month ~215 (COVERAGE_DESIGN.md; corrected paying-day count incl. same-day fixtures).

football_settlement._note: V2-19: lowered 60->50 (Plan A projection 0-20; scores only for leagues with started pending bets) | 2026-10-08: 50->20 (observed 0 in Oct; Plan A 0-20) to fund NHL/NFL

tennis_prediction_board._note: pays per active key only if >=1 not-yet-started event is listed (free /events); no horizon gate (would alter the frozen first-snapshot rule)

us_sports_board._note: NHL + NFL moneyline (2026-10-08): <=1 odds call per sport per UTC day, only with games within 36h; scores every 2nd day (2 credits) when predictions are due. Cap 40 fits the 425 operating budget (Plan A tennis 150 unchanged); the guard stops US calls when reached, so NHL coverage may be partial late in a month.

football_shadow_tiers._doc: Tier 2 (prospective shadow) and Tier 3 (conditional shadow) leagues pay only while remaining >= base + days_left_in_month x sum(protected_daily_need of the consumers they protect); base = max(global_reserve_remaining, largest consumer min_remaining). Tier 3 stops first, then Tier 2; Tier 1 is never sacrificed. Logged as consumer football_shadow_scan.

protected_daily_need._settlement: legacy /scores, E0/E1/SC0 only, expected ~10/month (Plan A 0-20) / 30, rounded up

pre_close_capture._doc: H2 PRE_CLOSE_VALUE (research/platform_v2/track_a/H2_PREREGISTRATION.md; approved 2026-10-02). Diagnostic only. One /odds call (h2h, uk = 1 credit) per sport key per capture run, only when a paper selection starts within capture_window_minutes. Pays only while remaining >= the Tier-2 shadow floor (protects Tier-1 football, tennis, NBA, settlement) and monthly spend < monthly_cap. Consumer pre_close_capture in the credit ledger.
pre_close_capture._active_from: H2 go-live; selections decided before this are not counted as missed captures

clv_capture._doc: CLV capture (directive 2026-10-08 18:37: up to 120 credits/month approved from genuinely unused budget). Surplus-only: pays only while remaining >= the Tier-2 shadow floor (protects Tier-1 football, tennis, NBA, settlement) + extra_protected_daily_need x days left (config/clv.yaml, US sports), and monthly spend < monthly_cap and daily spend < daily_cap. One /odds call per sport key per capture run (h2h = 1 credit; the response includes Betfair lay prices). Own ledger research_shadow/clv/credit_ledger.csv (in credit_report). Not part of consumers, so no core cap changes.
